purpose: Challenge the selected Campaign046 return-reversal-energy mechanism against the complete terminal and prospective frontier before freezing a formula implementation or reading any Campaign046 candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_return_reversal_energy_share_236p
selected_mechanism.formula: For each 120-close half, form 119 adjacent log returns and 118 ordered adjacent-return pairs (a,b). Pool the two halves to 236 pairs, set W=sum(abs(a*b)) and O=sum(abs(a*b) where a*b<0), and return O/W.
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher fixed share indicates that more one-minute adjacent return-product energy is absorbed through direction reversal rather than propagated through continuation, potentially leaving a more resilient completed-session price-discovery state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 raw unadjusted one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.half_session_rule: Form 119 returns and 118 ordered adjacent pairs independently inside each half; never include lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transitions.
selected_mechanism.weight_rule: Every pair contributes abs(a*b) to W. A pair contributes the same nonnegative weight to O only when a*b is strictly negative.
selected_mechanism.zero_rule: Retain every exact-zero return in fixed support. A zero product contributes zero to O and W and does not bridge neighboring returns.
selected_mechanism.normalization_rule: Require finite W>0 and return O/W; no centering, standardization, volatility scaling, clipping, winsorization, or rank transform is allowed.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid selected close, nonfinite log return/product/aggregate, W<=0, or score outside [0,1] before 1e-12 endpoint canonicalization makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: The terminal absorption factor conditions only on negative initiators followed by positive returns and weights by destination-bar CNY amount. Campaign046 treats positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive reversals symmetrically, weights by the exact adjacent return-product magnitude, and reads no amount.

Those factors count sign states, with sign-run imbalance distinguishing positive from negative continuation and bar continuity using open-close bodies. Campaign046 uses between-close returns, treats both reversal directions identically, and weights by continuous return-product energy rather than counts.

Campaign028 centers adjacent absolute-return vectors and measures Pearson magnitude persistence without signs. Campaign046 uses no correlation or centering and allocates their uncentered product energy exclusively by opposite versus same signs.

Diffusive variation ignores product signs and scales total adjacent absolute products by realized variance; the five-minute ratio aggregates signed returns over overlapping windows. Campaign046 uses neither realized-variance nor multi-minute-sum denominators and measures the sign allocation of adjacent product energy.

Campaign039 uses a signed antisymmetric cubic contrast a*b*(a-b) and one post-pooling absolute value to measure time irreversibility. Campaign046 uses only abs(a*b) and a strict opposite-sign indicator; pair order reversal does not change its local contribution.

Those mechanisms summarize marginal sign/moment or ordinal-state composition. Campaign046 is ordering-sensitive on adjacent return pairs, uses exact magnitudes, and contains no marginal moment, triple state, or entropy.
Those mechanisms use endpoints, price-level geometry, chords, or extrema. Campaign046 has no price-level anchor or terminal displacement and depends only on adjacent within-half return products.

Campaign045 and the amount/volume families measure activity coupling, lead-lag, transaction prices, or arrival profiles. Campaign046 reads close only and contains no amount, volume, activity transform, or activity alignment.

Campaign046 contains no peer benchmark, disclosure field, event timing, VWAP, volume, or amount and remains historical-research-only. Candidate49 stays future-only and enters only as a no-return comparison.
Campaign046 contains one exact raw-close statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, or combination.

decision.next_action: Bind this record, append terminal Campaign045 to the inherited 68-factor order, freeze one exact post-admission development trial, and run the binding validator before implementation.
